scope: Copied snapshot of git tracked + untracked nonignored public product files; excludes private parent, ignored build/runtime data and this generated report.
review_method: Each finding independently matches an evidence source-hash field or archived-file manifest and the SHA-256 of the exact recorded Git blob, copied current public file, or individually identified historical public Git blob. No blanket suppression.
scope_limitations: A clean scanner result does not prove absence of all secrets.

Final frozen public VM, CI, release/build and documentation records present in this snapshot are covered. Any later change requires comparison with scanned_files_sha256 and rescanning before publication.
Private household/runtime files and ignored build/media data were not collected.
